proposals.title: Exposure concentration: by_regime + by_signal_type + by_signal_type×sector = Bull=100%, UP_TRI=98.4%, UP_TRI×Bull×Bank=20.31% (100.0%)

claim.what: Concentration risk: by_regime + by_signal_type + by_signal_type×sector = Bull=100%, UP_TRI=98.4%, UP_TRI×Bull×Bank=20.31%; recommended action: Pause new UP_TRI entries in Bank sector until Bank share drops below 15% via natural Day-6 exits; additionally pause any new UP_TRI entries broadly until non-UP_TRI or hedge exposure lifts signal_type diversification above 15% of book. Consider adding an index-short or BEAR_PROXY hedge sized to ~10-15% of gross exposure to blunt tail risk.
claim.expected_effect: Trader awareness of tail risk: A Bull→Choppy or Bull→Bear regime flip would hit 100% of the book simultaneously with no offsetting exposure, and Bank concentration (20%+) amplifies drawdown if financials lead the reversal (rate shock, credit event, or NBFC contagion). Cohort edge is unvalidated (Candidate n=87), so there is no historical basis to expect UP_TRI×Bull to survive a regime shift with positive expectancy.
